_comment: Shared fallback config for carve and dispatch-work. Lean is model-invoked and does not read this file. Copy it to ~/.config/lean/lean.config.json or <project>/.config/lean/lean.config.json and edit it. The bundled copy is a read-only default replaced on plugin updates.

subagent._comment: The single model used by carve and dispatch-work. A repository model policy may override it. If model is Anthropic/Claude, effort must be high or lower.
